reason: Workflow files installed through the user-authorized GitHub integration; router committed through Issue 6.

files.body:
name: Issue 6 Meta Instructor
on:
  workflow_call:
permissions: {}
jobs:
  interact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Verify controller and existing console regressions
        run: node --test workspaces/meta-instructor/controller.test.cjs tests/issue6-gh-command.test.cjs tests/issue6-route.test.cjs tests/issue6-commit.test.cjs
      - name: Advance the interactive application
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node workspaces/meta-instructor/issue6-adapter.cjs

name: Issue 6 GitHub CLI
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited]

# No default token privileges. The route-specific jobs request only what they need.
permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: issue-6-gh-${{ github.event.comment.id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  preprocess:
    if: ${{ github.event.issue.number == 6 && github.event.sender.type != 'Bot' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      route: ${{ steps.route.outputs.route }}
    env:
      ISSUE6_INPUT_COMMENT_ID: '6358997143'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: route
        name: Select exactly one command workflow
        run: node runtime/issue6-route.cjs

  read-only-command:
    needs: preprocess
    if: ${{ needs.preprocess.outputs.route == 'gh' || needs.preprocess.outputs.route == 'normalize' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/issue-6-standard.yml

  commit:
    needs: preprocess
    if: ${{ needs.preprocess.outputs.route == 'commit' }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/issue-6-commit.yml

  meta-instructor:
    needs: preprocess
    if: ${{ needs.preprocess.outputs.route == 'meta' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/issue-6-meta.yml
